cues: That tendency is measured by entropy, S, a measure of the randomness or disorder of a system.
For a change carried out reversibly at temperature T, delta S is the heat absorbed reversibly, divided by T.
text: That tendency is measured by entropy, S, a measure of the randomness or disorder of a system. It is a state function. For a change carried out reversibly at temperature T, delta S is the heat absorbed reversibly, divided by T.
